name: White earthenware body (Tang sancai: white kaolin with a little loessic clay, low-fired)

diffuseAlbedo.source: Palette.json: accent.earthenware-sancai ; J. Y. Shen, J. Henderson, J. Evans, S. Chenery and F. Y. Zhao, 'A study of the glazing techniques and provenances of Tang sancai glazes using elemental and lead isotope analyses', Archaeometry 61, 2 (2019) 358-373, doi:10.1111/arcm.12436, https://nora.nerc.ac.uk/522694/1/Shen_et_al-2019-Archaeometry.pdf
diffuseAlbedo.note: Shen et al.: the sancai 'white' is a colourless glaze on a white body, white kaolin (Al2O3 about 30 %, FeO under 2.5 %, TiO2 about 1 %). No photograph of a bare body was read: a first value, a faintly warm white, for a kaolin body low-fired; under the glazes it shows only as glaze.sancai-clear.

refractiveIndex.source: Substances/brick.json (Shading): fired clay is quartz, feldspar and glass, indices 1.5 to 1.6
refractiveIndex.note: The middle of the fired body's mineral indices, as the brick's and the porcelain's.

porosity.note: A low-fired earthenware body stays open (it is fired below vitrification); no measurement of a Tang sancai body's porosity was read.

wettingDepth.note: The depth whose pores govern the face's look when wet; under the glaze it never wets.

grain.note: The finest structure the face shows.

bed.note: The coarsest structure the face shows.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across one face.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across one face.
